end.summary:
Practised reading and writing 4-digit numbers in words and numerals.
Used place-value language: thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones.
For “do hazaar teen sau paintalees,” Diya corrected the numeral to 2335.
Repeatedly left out the zero in an empty place, such as writing 4050 as 450; this was not corrected after the last seen instance.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised place value and converting number names into numerals with Diya. Diya worked through “do hazaar teen sau paintalees” by adding 2000 + 300 + 35 and reached 2335. They mixed up the empty tens/ones place and left out zero, so at home, practise numbers such as 4050 using a place-value chart and say each place aloud.
